sla.rationale.fail: Status "{label}": the SLA does not confirm the target result of the test.
sla.rationale.fail_failed: Status "{label}": mandatory SLA criteria are breached ({failed}).
sla.rationale.fail_target: Status "{label}": the target RPS is not reached ({actual} {op} {threshold}).

sla.rationale.pass: Status "{label}": the checked SLA criteria are met.
sla.rationale.pass_target: Status "{label}": the target RPS is reached ({actual} ≥ {threshold}), no secondary SLA threshold is breached.
sla.rationale.risk: Status "{label}": not every SLA criterion could be confirmed with numbers.
sla.rationale.risk_failed: Status "{label}": criteria {failed} are breached, with no clear failure on the target RPS.
sla.rationale.risk_target: Status "{label}": the target RPS is reached, but secondary thresholds are breached ({failed}).

sla.recovery.not_recovered: Latency did not return to the background level after: {spikes}
sla.recovery.not_recovered_limit: Latency did not return to the background level (±{tolerance} %) within {limit} min after: {spikes}
sla.recovery.partial: Recovery was not evaluated for every spike: no latency points after a spike

sla.summary.adjust_resources: {mode} mode: CPU/memory overruns are treated as risks, but without breaches of target_rps/error_rate/p95/p99 they do not turn the test into "{fail}".
sla.summary.adjust_trend: The SLA thresholds are met, but an adverse trend was found over the hold window: {trends}
sla.summary.head: SLA verdict: {label}.
sla.summary.mode_spike: Spike mode: thresholds are checked in the spike windows (the worst spike), target_rps is the spike level; a breach of target_rps or recovery is "{fail}", latency and errors in the spike window are risks
sla.summary.mode_stability: Stability mode: thresholds are checked on the hold window, target_rps is the mean level to hold; CPU/memory are secondary risks and do not turn the test into "{fail}" by themselves
sla.summary.no_checks: No SLA criterion could be checked (no matching metrics)
